exposure: Gestational weight gain category according to 2009 Institute of Medicine guidelines
cohort: 2,765 women with singleton full-term births who attempted a vaginal delivery
finding: Obese women, particularly those with inadequate or excessive gestational weight gain, were at increased risk of emergency cesarean section.
mod_finding: Obese women with inadequate and excessive gestational weight gain had a higher risk of emergency cesarean section compared to obese women with adequate weight gain and those with normal BMI.
